title: Compactness of composition operator on weighted Bergman spaces of the polydisc
summary: We study composition operators induced by a smooth symbol between weighted Bergman spaces of the polydisc. We first prove a compactness criterion that only requires knowing what happens on the distinguished boundary. Then we prove simple geometric characterizations of boundedness and compactness on some $A^2_β(\mathbb{D}^d)$, particularly for $β> d-3$.
